LanguageData.RHA_StarPursuit030_Ready: Hunter closing in — watch its facing.
LanguageData.RHA_StarPursuit030_Windup: Charge locked — {0}s. Leave the marked route!
LanguageData.RHA_StarPursuit030_Brief: The hunter can always be damaged. Its charge route locks before a 1.5-second warning; move sideways or use cover. A missed or blocked charge leaves it off balance for 4 seconds; contact leaves a 1.5-second opening. It takes 35% more damage during either opening. Existing control abilities can interrupt it. Defeat the hunter after dealing personal damage equal to 20% of its core health, or earn 12 points through your shields and healing of trial damage. Allies may help and finish it. No skill is granted for this trial.
